title: 25 New Pence - Elizabeth II (Queen Mother)

obverse.description: Second crowned portrait of Queen Elizabeth II right, wearing the Girls of Great Britain and Ireland tiara, legend around
obverse.unabridged_legend: Elizabeth II Dei Gratia Regina Fidei Defensatrix
obverse.lettering_translation: Elizabeth II by the Grace of God Queen Defender of the Faith

reverse.description: Central portrait of the Queen Mother surrounded by a radiating pattern of symbolic bows and lions, which are an allusion to her family name.
reverse.lettering:
QUEEN ELIZABETH THE QUEEN MOTHER
AUGUST 4th 1980

commemorated_topic: 80th birthday of Queen Elizabeth the Queen Mother
comments:
Despite being produced in their millions and being available at face value from most post offices and banks, the ordinary business strike was a Royal Mint commemorative issue and not intended for general circulation. 

 

The coin was also issued in a presentation card.


This was the first time in the history of United Kingdom coinage that a reigning monarch appeared on the same coin as her mother.

Elizabeth Angela Marguerite Bowes-Lyon (4 August 1900 – 30 March 2002) was the wife of King George VI and the mother of Queen Elizabeth II and Princess Margaret. She was known as Queen Elizabeth, The Queen Mother, to avoid confusion with her daughter. She was the last Empress consort of India.

Planchet thickness The coin thickness measures 2.9 mm at the centre and 3.2 mm at the rim.

(former Spink ref. 4228)
